strongest_verified_claim: For each fixed smooth uniformly elliptic symmetric tensor and smooth positive invariant density on a known bounded connected smooth domain, with known pointwise bounds and exact stationary reversible conormally reflected observations at known fixed positive lag, the specified all-positive-mode empirical spectral ridge estimator recovers S and a separately fitted div S locally uniformly almost surely, its clipped tensor converges globally in L2, and the density converges in C2. Every deterministic positive ridge tending to zero works. The separate Sobolev-regularized forward-kernel alternative also has the stated consistency.
